answer: An farming party therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The relic counter is kept in knoll and meadow reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 21 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
